title: feat(search): add opt-in fuzzy matching
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Add opt-in fuzzy search helpers to `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search`.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

Roadmap item #17 lists fuzzy search for `plugin-search` as a planned P2 feature with no OpenSpec required. This PR implements the first helper-level version without changing CodeMirror's built-in search panel behavior.

- Issue: N/A
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): #17 Fuzzy search
- OpenSpec change: N/A — Roadmap #17 marks "Needs OpenSpec" as No

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`:
  - No changes.

- `packages/plugin-*`:
  - `packages/plugin-search`:
    - Added `fuzzy?: boolean` and `maxResults?: number` to `SearchOptions`.
    - Added optional fuzzy metadata to `SearchMatch`: `score?: number` and `positions?: number[]`.
    - Added a dependency-free `fuzzyMatch()` helper in `src/fuzzy.ts`.
    - Added bounded backtracking for short candidates and greedy fallback for long candidates.
    - Added `findFuzzySearchMatches()` and integrated fuzzy mode into `findSearchMatches()`.
    - Treats `fuzzy` and `regexp` as mutually exclusive; using both returns no matches.
    - Keeps fuzzy replacement out of scope: `replaceAllMatches(..., { fuzzy: true })` returns the original document.
    - Supports line-level fuzzy candidates by default and word-level candidates when `wholeWord` is combined with `fuzzy`.

- `apps/electron-demo`:
  - No changes.

- `openspec/`:
  - No changes. This roadmap item does not require OpenSpec.

- `docs/`:
  - Updated Roadmap item #17 from `planned` to `in-progress`.

## Behavior / 行为说明

```ts
findSearchMatches("Nexus Markdown Editor", "nme", { fuzzy: true });
